written_rules: A frame appearing on a position is held for the remainder of the FREE SPINS FEATURE and the SUPER SAW FREE SPINS. Each position may have only 1 frame at a given time.

symbol_frame_progression.FREE SPINS FEATURE: A frame appears on a position and remains there until the end of the FREE SPINS FEATURE.
symbol_frame_progression.SUPER SAW FREE SPINS: A frame appears on a position and remains there until the end of the SUPER SAW FREE SPINS.
